QuestInfo.name: Edea and Piston
QuestInfo.0: Learn about Heliseum Reclamation HQ from #bEdea#k.
QuestInfo.1: Inform #bPiston#k that you've joined Heliseum Reclamation HQ.
QuestInfo.2: Get the mission details from Piston.

0.0: A very warm welcome to the land of dragons. It's only unfortunate that we're not meeting you under happier circumstances.\r\n
0.1: Our forces have grown stronger, but we are still vulnerable in a lot of ways.\r\n
0.2: We'll need a lot of help while we rebuild Reclamation HQ, and having you would be a very useful addition to our team.\r\n
0.3: Ask Captain #bPiston#k here for details. Oh, and welcome to Grandis, land of the dragons. Enjoy your stay.\r\n

yes.0: Just familiarize yourself with your responsibilities for now.\r\n

no.0: Thank you for your help so far, but I won't beg you for more.\r\n

0.msg: #b(You explain that Beldar recommended you for Heliseum Reclamation HQ.)#k\r\n

yes.0: Ah, a foreigner. Welcome. I'm Piston, the commander of the troops here.\r\n
yes.1: Thanks to you, the Specters that invaded HQ are no longer a problem. With your help, there's no way we'll lose!\r\n
yes.2: Now, I just need to figure out the best way to use your skill set. Give me a minute, here.\r\n

default.0: Ask Captain #bPiston#k here for details. Oh, and welcome to Grandis, land of the dragons. Enjoy your stay.\r\n
